next_experiments_needed.proposed_factor: Only replace G's primary full-unit batch-hard soft Triplet with the repository's existing hinge TripletLoss at the existing fixed SOLVER.MARGIN=0.3.
next_experiments_needed.implementation_boundary: Intercept only the first fused loss call, retaining fused CE=0.25 and metric coefficient=1; use max(0, d_ap-d_an+0.3) on the same normalized5120 feature and same hard-positive/negative mining. Leave auxiliary Triplet calls as they are. Do not set global NO_MARGIN=False because that would also alter auxiliary losses.
rationale_from_observed_evidence: G retains primary unit soft Triplet and already has zero partial-loss gradients, yet normal retrieval falls sharply after an early best on all three datasets while training loss generally falls. This makes the primary ranking pressure a useful direct factor to test without adding architecture.

H changes the primary objective and is stable but weaker in selected normal performance; adopting H outright is not supported. The existing hinge keeps direct metric learning while stopping its gradient after the fixed margin is met.

The soft-margin loss has nonzero ranking pressure even on correctly ordered finite-distance triplets; this is a source-level mathematical property, not an observed causal diagnosis. The hinge's satisfied-margin zero gradient gives a precise, testable distinction without introducing a new loss module or sweeping temperatures/weights.
The margin 0.3 already exists in config/defaults.py, and the implementation already exists in layers/triplet_loss.py. No margin sweep or new dataset-specific setting is proposed.
next_experiments_needed.limitations_of_rationale: No claim that soft Triplet caused the late decline, that G's late descriptors moved in a measured direction, or that margin0.3 will meet the goal. H's small AP loss alone is not treated as proof of absent gradients. This is a controlled next test, not a validated solution.
